name: Fricasseed Tripe
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: a small cup of water or milk

ingredients.quantityText: a small cup of water or milk

instructions.text: Cut a pound of tripe in narrow strips
Put a small cup of water or milk to it, add a bit of butter the size of an egg
Dredge in a large teaspoonful of flour, or work it with the butter
Let it simmer gently for half an hour
Serve hot with a bunch of parsley cut small as an improvement

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut a pound of tripe in narrow strips
2. Put a small cup of water or milk to it, add a bit of butter the size of an egg
3. Dredge in a large teaspoonful of flour, or work it with the butter
4. Season with pepper and salt
5. Let it simmer gently for half an hour
6. Serve hot with a bunch of parsley cut small as an improvement
